findings.claim: kmctl plugin patch --help and the no-kmctl-package refusal pointed at the README's install section, which the root README no longer has

verdict.text: This was a narrow round 2 review.
f1 is resolved: both strings now point at the install section of kmctl's README, and packages/kmctl/README.md has a `## Install` section at line 19.
The fix changed only wording and broke nothing.

packages/kmctl/src/kmctl/__init__.py:1063, the end of the plugin patch help text: "Installing is in the install section of kmctl's README." packages/kmctl/src/kmctl/plugin.py:800-801, the PluginError raised when apm.lock.yaml lists no kmctl package: "(the install section of kmctl's README)".
The f-string concatenation still reads correctly.
Searched the package sources for the old wording.
The other hits in kmctl's source (__init__.py:164, init's Next line) already say "the kmctl README's install section", which is correct.
No test asserts the changed strings.
Ran `loopctl gate stamp` in the worktree myself: lint, format, tests and integration pass, eval rows r1 to r5 pass, "stamp green: 0025eda9368e438c1a503ac44d92547d4fc10005ad0bad314a5781f3726e57e5".
Both now name kmctl's README, which has the install section.
This change did not touch that line, and a narrow round does not cover it.
An operator may want to change it to name kmctl's README in a follow-up.
